coverage_policy.rule: Acquire global datasets where the source is global; acquire India-wide inventories where national; retain NER as a deployment/test subset, not the sole training universe. Never spatially filter global sources during acquisition unless storage constraints require a documented derivative.

nasa_coolr_events.notes: Global event-based landslide inventories; retain global records and derive NER subsets later.

nasa_coolr_reports.notes: Global report-based landslide observations; preserve report provenance and event linkage.

nasa_global_landslide_catalog_export.notes: Historical NASA GLC snapshot; preserve its snapshot date and source hash.

unified_global_landslide_catalog.notes: 2026 Unified Global Landslide Catalogue; point and polygon products; preserve CC BY-NC 4.0 licensing.

isro_landslide_atlas_india.notes: ~80,000 India landslides, 1998-2022; acquire India-wide and derive NER subset later.

gsi_bhusanket_field_validated.notes: GSI field-validated inventory; acquire India-wide from Download Data facility.

usgs_earthquakes.notes: Global earthquake catalog; retain all relevant events and derive windows downstream.

osm_global_or_regional.notes: Use regional extracts as needed; NER is an operational derivative.

soilgrids_2.notes: Global 250 m soil properties and uncertainty.

hydrobasins_global.notes: Global basin hierarchy; official download may return 403 from CI.

hydrorivers_global.notes: Global river network; preserve HydroSHEDS version.

open_meteo_archive.notes: Historical weather for event-time histories; batch requests spatially/temporally.

gpm_imerg.notes: Global precipitation; Earthdata authentication required for archive access.

era5_land.notes: 1950-present hourly reanalysis; CDS credentials required for bulk access.

copernicus_dem.notes: Global DEM; use validated 30 m where authorized/publicly available and 90 m otherwise.

sentinel_1.notes: Global SAR; acquire event-focused imagery, not indiscriminate global archives.

sentinel_2.notes: Global optical EO; acquire event-focused imagery with cloud/quality filtering.

isro_bhuvan_landslide.notes: India-wide seasonal/event/route inventories; NER is a subset.

global_landslide_hazard_distribution.notes: Susceptibility/context feature only; never use as an event label.
